s1.cue: Only a large owl face on a plain green background; no words at all.

first_pass.why: There is no text, so I have to assume from the empty screen and the logo that the app is starting; nothing says loading.
first_pass.solution: A line of text such as 'Loading' under the logo.

test_cases.action: Close the app completely (swipe it away or press the home button and relaunch from the phone), open Duolingo again, and watch the very first screen. Say what you see and whether you can tell what is happening.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell what is happening on the first screen
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell the app is starting
test_cases.what_happened: I closed Duolingo and opened it again, twice. Both times, by the first screenshot I could take, the app was already on the path screen with 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Order at a café' at the top. I never caught the plain owl screen from the picture; if it appears, it passes faster than I can look.

s1.closing_comment: On the real phone the wordless owl screen passes so fast that I never saw it, so it barely strands anyone, although it would still be clearer with a word such as 'Loading'.

s2.where: Choosing a course to learn, probably at sign-up
s2.expectation: A list of courses where I pick one and press CONTINUE.
s2.cue: The question 'What would you like to learn?', the heading 'For English speakers', and the list of languages.

first_pass.why: The question says literally what this screen is for, and the list matches it.

s3.where: The home learning screen, on a unit called 'Hot Cross Buns – Zari's version'
s3.expectation: The main path screen, but mostly empty.
s3.cue: The pink bar 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 / Hot Cross Buns – Zari's version' and the highlighted house in the bottom bar.

first_pass.why: The house tells me this is home, but the unit name is the name of a song and a person, not a description of what I am learning, and the rest of the screen is blank.
first_pass.solution: A unit title that says literally what the unit teaches, and content on the page, or a 'Loading' message while it fills.

test_cases.action: Open the app and let the first screen settle. Look at it for a few seconds without scrolling and say where you think you are. Then tap the second picture in the row along the bottom, then tap the first picture again, and say whether you can tell you are back where you started.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot name the place, or cannot tell you are back
test_cases.not_real_if: you can name it and recognise it when you come back
test_cases.what_happened: The first screen showed 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Order at a café' at the top and the house highlighted in the bottom row, so I knew I was on the learning path for that unit. The unit was 'Order at a café', not 'Hot Cross Buns'. I tapped the second picture and got 'Quests' with its picture highlighted. I tapped the house again and was back on the same path with the same title and the house highlighted again. Out of scope: the shape at the bottom of the path kept switching between a '2' badge, a flag and an exclamation mark between my screenshots, without me doing anything.

s3.closing_comment: Live, the unit title was the literal 'Order at a café' and the page was filled in, so the song-title unit and the blank path in the picture were not what I met.
